rules.expression: (http.host in {"ermolov.dev" "www.ermolov.dev"}) and (http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}) and http.request.uri.path eq "/index.html"

rules.description: Canonical apex for public pages and assets
rules.expression: http.host eq "www.ermolov.dev" and (http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}) and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cdn-cgi/")
